data.body: LIVE MIGRATION RAN: 104 tickets migrated via edit_ticket (operator-approved full run, incl. 3 non-closed). Pre-run restore file captured at /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-sc-migration-restore-2026-07-25.json (104 old descriptions, 674KB) addressing the plan review's 'no rollback path' advisory; rebar's per-ticket revert to a prior event UUID is the second rollback route since every edit is an auditable event. Post-run verification: 0 migrated tickets below the AC floor, 0 missing from store, re-running proposes 0 further changes. BUT verification found a SECOND oracle gap: 2 tickets (ace2 '## Success Criteria (target state)', d6a0 '## Success Criteria (outcomes, not mechanisms)') were SILENTLY SKIPPED because heading detection is exact-string-match. Scanned the whole store for variants: exactly those 2, no case/whitespace variants. The other 8 tickets still matching the string are backticked PROSE mentions (the epic's own tickets discussing the migration) and are correctly left alone. Added 5 RED held-out cases (4 heading variants + a prose-mention guard proving the other direction) and re-dispatched. Both Gerrit changes 969 and 971 are LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1.
